text:
Emily L: quick sync — I pasted the postmortem notes in the doc. we need clear owners/timelines for correcting the token backlog and customer-facing fixes.
Sasha B: short summary for folks who haven't seen the doc: ingest delay on 2025-03-12 created ~2.3M tokens backlog. invoices for that window were generated before the backlog drained. root cause points to intermittent kafka consumer failures + long GC pauses.
Jordan K: confirmed. billing-worker-03 had a GC pause at 02:17 that aligned with consumer lag. snippet from logs: 
```
billing-worker-03 | ERROR | commit failed: TimeoutException
billing-worker-03 | WARN  | long GC pause 18s
```
Raj P: ops saw a canary deploy that night. suspect `consumer.max.poll.interval.ms` was bumped in prod override. will investigate config drift.
Maria S: impact: ~120 customers affected; finance suggest credits for balances under $100 and full invoice reissues over $100 (need legal OK for reissue wording).
Emily L: propose split of work: Sasha owns issuing credits (small accounts) — target Fri EOD; Jordan owns generating corrected invoices for larger customers — target next Tue; Raj to own infra fixes and alerts — PR and deployment in 48h; Maria to own customer comms. ok?
Sasha B: I can take credits. need accounting query with list + amounts by tomorrow EOD. ETA credits run Fri 6pm PT.
Jordan K: will produce corrected usage payloads and exercise the invoice regen script in sandbox. will validate tax calc parity. ETA Tue 11am PT.
Raj P: ops will add a consumer max poll guard (fail-fast) and a restart watchdog for billing-worker pods. PR incoming in ~2hrs. also adding a kafka-consumer-lag smoke check -> alert if > 5 for 10m.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-889 (billing-ingest-backlog). Linked: postmortem-doc-2025-03-12. Assignees: ops, billing, finance.
Maria S: I'll draft a customer notification template and circulate. suggested wording: short apology, explanation of underreported usage, statement of remediation (credit or corrected invoice), contact flow.
Emily L: checklist to track here: (1) accounting query (Maria) (2) credits run (Sasha) (3) invoice regen + validation (Jordan) (4) infra guard + alerts (Raj) (5) customer comms (Maria). add completion dates in-thread.
Sasha B: added to my calendar. I'll post a status update tomorrow AM.
Jordan K: running a small sample regen now to verify totals match expected. will report discrepancies.
Maria S: draft email posted to doc: "We discovered delayed metering that affected your invoice dated Mar 12. We are issuing a credit or corrected invoice depending on the amount. No action required on your side. Reach billing@redwood.com if questions." feedback welcome.
Emily L: also flagging recurrence: similar ledger drift occurred twice in Q4. recommend monthly metering stability retro for ops+billing+finance to catch recurrent patterns.
Raj P: agree — scheduling a 30m recurring sync starting next week. will include CI checks for consumer lag trends.
Sasha B: idea: add token-level aggregate checksums on ingest to detect skipped batches fast. spike in token delta should trigger an alert.
Jordan K: good call — I'll draft a lightweight checksum + delta metric and expose it to metrics.
Emily L: locking owners now. I'll update the postmortem doc with owners and due dates. tagging: @Sasha B @Jordan K @Raj P @Maria S :thumbsup: 
Sasha B: :thumbsup:
Jordan K: :+1:
Maria S: 👍
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up check in 72 hours for owner status updates.
